'''Wayfarer's Temples''' were buildings that housed shrines and chapels for a variety of religions, allowing visitors from different [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to worship at a shrine of their choice. One such temple was located in [[Falleen Throne]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]].
